Fraud_Detection_Rate.name: Fraud_Detection_Rate
Fraud_Detection_Rate.description: Percentage of actual fraud cases caught (Recall).

False_Positive_Rate.description: Percentage of legitimate transactions incorrectly flagged.

Alert_Rate.description: Ratio of flagged transactions to total transactions.

Alerts_per_1_000_Transactions.description: Number of alerts generated per 1,000 transactions.

Alerts_per_10_000_Transactions.name: Alerts_per_10_000_Transactions
Alerts_per_10_000_Transactions.description: Number of alerts generated per 10,000 transactions.

Alerts_per_100_000_Transactions.name: Alerts_per_100_000_Transactions
Alerts_per_100_000_Transactions.description: Number of alerts generated per 100,000 transactions.

Precision_At_K.name: Precision_At_K
Precision_At_K.description: Precision score evaluating only top 100 predicted scores.
